entities.name: Museum in the Kulturbrauerei
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Museum in the Kulturbrauerei is a museum of contemporary German history. The permanent exhibition focuses on everyday life in the German Democratic Republic. It is located in the Kulturbrauerei building complex in Prenzlauer Berg district in Berlin, Germany.
